caption: The drawing displays a centrally placed wooden object resembling a handled tool with a gear-like circular end, rendered in brown tones with textural details indicating wood grain. It is vertically oriented, with the handle extending downward and the circular, notched wheel at the top. Surrounding the central image are three rectangular insets containing black line drawings of the same object shown from different perspectives: a front view (bottom left), a side view (bottom right), and a detailed close-up of the mechanism at the intersection of the wheel and the handle (top center). The composition is organized within a thin rectangular border, and the name "GEORGE BEYER" appears at the lower right. The background is plain, off-white or beige, providing contrast to the brown and black elements of the drawing.
title: Cookie Cutter
